Name: Squash
Description: Create a Local Squash System (v002: v001 bend / squash on translate plus a lattice on rotate / scale, secondary row controllers)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Squash and stretch any geo with a lattice (v002: v001 bend / squash on translate plus a lattice driven by joints on rotate / scale, secondary controllers per lattice row).

How To Use:
  select the geo and make the block (SetGeo and the guides fit it), place the Base and Top guides, build.

Fields:
- SetGeo: geos to deform, separated by commas (empty makes a hidden dummy cube).
- SetParent: the block follows it (move, rotate, scale). new_locator makes a locator at world.
- Joints: lattice rows / joints from the Base guide to the Top guide (default 5).
- LatticeSides: lattice points across the width and depth (default 2).
- CtrlSize / CtrlColor: controllers look.
- Squash / Bend / SquashMult / ... / LockSecondaryAttrs: same as v001, the deformers sit on the geo (bottom to top).
- UseCustomPivots: shows Ctrl_Guide (under the Top guide), Squash_Ctrl sits there. Only the controller, the deformation keeps the geo, Base and Top guides.

Controllers:
- Squash_Ctrl translate: bend and squash deformers like v001 (Squash, Bend, SquashMult... values below, same as v001).
- Squash_Ctrl rotate: the lattice rows are an FK chain from the base, every row after the base turns by the same rotation (times RotationAmount), so they add up to an extra curve (2 rows: 1x, top row: 4x with 5 joints). Scale: scales the shape with a falloff (none on the base, all on the top).
- Squash_Top / Bottom / Left / Right_Ctrl: spheres on the lattice edges, they ride the rows and move their part of the lattice (Top / Bottom their row with a falloff to the other end, Left / Right their side, more in the middle).
- Squash_TopLeft / TopRight / BottomLeft / BottomRight_Ctrl: spheres on the lattice corners, their side with a falloff to the other end. Edges (EdgeCtrls) and corners (CornerCtrls) hidden by default.
- Squash_N_Ctrl: one per lattice row, rides the row, scale it for a bulge. Hidden by default (SubCtrls).
- Attrs on every controller (instanced Squash_Attrs_Loc shape): the bend / squash attrs, RotationAmount, SubCtrls, EdgeCtrls, CornerCtrls.

Tips:
- deformer order: skinCluster, lattice, bend front, bend side, squash.
- the lattice deforms all the geo, inside and outside of it (outside points follow the closest rows).
